$comment: Fuaran runtime-introspection tool definitions for the closed-loop authoring pattern. Anthropic tool-use shape (name / description / input_schema); for the OpenAI shape, wrap each as { "type": "function", "function": { name, description, parameters: input_schema } }. These four tools are the public Fuaran.UI.AiTools surface — they let an AI observe what the renderer did with an emitted tree and retry against authoritative runtime state.

tools.name: fuaran_getNodeState
tools.description: Inspect a rendered node by id: its kind, current lifecycle state (Normal/Loading/Empty/Error), resolved props, binding resolutions, and geometry. Use after emitting a tree to confirm it rendered, or to branch a retry on CurrentState. An empty `include` returns every block.

include.description: Which detail blocks to return. Omit or pass [] for all.

tools.name: fuaran_getBindingValue
tools.description: Resolve one binding slot on a node to its current value (or a BindingError). Use when getNodeState reports CurrentState=Loading to confirm whether a query has arrived.

slot.description: The binding slot name on that node's kind, e.g. "Source" or "Trend" on a Metric.

tools.name: fuaran_getRenderedDom
tools.description: Return the rendered geometry tree rooted at a node — (x, y, width, height, overflowing) per descendant. Use to detect layout problems (children overflowing parents, zero-height grids). Returns ProbeUnwired if the host bound no geometry probe.

id.description: The NodeId to root the geometry tree at.

tools.name: fuaran_getRuntimeErrors
tools.description: Return the runtime-error stream (decoder failures, unwired actions, binding-resolution exceptions), optionally filtered to errors recorded after a given turn. Use to diagnose 'I emitted a tree but nothing rendered'.

since_turn.description: Only return errors recorded after this turn number. Omit for all.
